name: projectdb
description: Query the local projects database. Search, list, or get info about projects in /Users/jonatan/sources.

arguments.description: Command and arguments: 'recent [N]', 'search <term>', 'lang', 'list', 'info <name>', 'large', or raw SQL with 'query <sql>'

examples: query SELECT name, language FROM projects WHERE language='TypeScript' LIMIT 5
